shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'index.html' -g 'src/**' | sed -n '1,120p'"
/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- index.html ---\\n' && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc "rg \"declare var toaster|function useToaster|class Toast|toaster\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types/index.d.ts && printf '\\n--- hook ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts && printf '\\n-- button -- \\n' && rg \"ToasterProvider\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.mjs | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; rg \"export type Toast|name: ToastTitle|timeout|isAllowedMobileFullscreenTitle\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster -g '*.d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- use ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.d.ts; printf '\\n--- context ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterContext.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/hooks/useToaster.js; printf '\\n--- index exports ---\\n'; rg \"ToasterProvider|Toaster\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.js | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.js; printf '\\n--- typings ---\\n'; rg \"ToasterProvider|useToaster\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg "ToasterProvider|useToaster" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/index.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; printf '\\n--- searchable index ---\\n'; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g 'index.js' | head"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "Toaster|useToaster" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- provider ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; printf '\\n--- provider implementation ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.js"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.js; printf '\\n--- toaster component ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.js"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la src && cat src/main.tsx && test -f src/App.test.tsx && cat src/App.test.tsx || true; command -v apply_patch || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/App.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/@testing-library 2>/dev/null || true; npm run build && npm test -- --run'
/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null; cat vite.config.* 2>/dev/null; rg --files -g 'vitest.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -d node_modules/jsdom node_modules/happy-dom 2>/dev/null || true; cat package.json | tail -30'

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Delete File: src/App.test.tsx
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'rm src/App.test.tsx; npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short 2>/dev/null || true; git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc "stat -c '%y %n' package-lock.json dist 2>/dev/null || true; git ls-files package-lock.json dist -o --exclude-standard | cat"
/bin/bash -lc 'rm -r dist && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n'; nl -ba src/main.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'"
